signature: SUBROUTINE ZTRTTF( TRANSR, UPLO, N, A, LDA, ARF, INFO )

params.name: transr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: `ARF` in Normal mode is wanted;
-   `= 'C'`: `ARF` in Conjugate Transpose mode is wanted;

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the triangular matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading N-by-N upper triangular part of the array A contains the upper triangular matrix, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading N-by-N lower triangular part of the array A contains the lower triangular matrix, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: ARF
params.reference: On exit, the upper or lower triangular matrix A stored in RFP format. For a further discussion see Notes below.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
